fontFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

themeVariables.fontFamily: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

themeCSS: .node.accent > rect, .node.accent > polygon, .node.accent > path { fill: #12312b !important; stroke: #5fceb3 !important; stroke-width: 1.6px !important; } .node.accent text, .node.accent tspan { fill: #ebf1f4 !important; } .edgeLabel rect { fill: #030c10 !important; } .cluster > rect { stroke-dasharray: 4 3 !important; }
